'''Norman''' was a newscaster working for the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] program ''[[A Galaxy Divided]]'' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Norman introduced an excerpt from an address that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] gave to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. He also referred the program to a discussion table hosted by [[Lyrax Pentigure]].
